issues.description: Class 'Lecture' field visibility differs between artifacts: the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declares lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents as public, whereas the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) and the reference solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declare these attributes as private and include three additional private attributes (numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). This inconsistency can confuse students about the intended encapsulation model (whether fields should be public or private) and whether they must implement getters/setters and follow the UML-specified attribute set and order for the constructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template's Lecture.java to match the UML and the reference solution: change lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents to private and add the remaining attributes as private (numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). Keep the existing TODO comments for implementing the constructor, getters/setters and other methods so students still implement them, but ensure the field visibilities and attribute list/order align with the specification to avoid confusion about encapsulation and constructor parameter order.
